Hi Aditya —

Attached is the latest hall floorplan (TechScale_floorplan_v5.pdf) and a marked-up drawing showing the demo pit we penciled in next to island D3. A couple of quick items we need to lock down from your side by EOD Thurs (Mar 23):

- Confirm demo pit footprint (current mark is 10' x 12') and whether you need a riser.
- Loader/unloader window preference: morning (7–9am) or afternoon (3–5pm). We have limited dock slots on Wed move-in.
- Any hard signage rigging needs (max point load / height) so we can route to rigging vendor.

If you prefer, we can set a 20-min call today to walk the plan; otherwise reply with confirmations and we'll finalize the move-in schedule.

Attaching: TechScale_floorplan_v5.pdf (floor plan, 2MB)

Thanks Emily — quick answers below, plus a few asks for clarification.

1) Demo pit footprint: confirmed at 10' x 12'. We will NOT need a raised riser (flat demo surface only). Please leave a 3' service aisle behind the pit for staff.

2) Loader/unloader: prefer morning slot (7–9am) on Wed move-in if available. We have two crates that need forklift access and a wooden demo crate that should be wheeled directly to the demo pit.

3) Signage rigging: we plan to hang one 8' banner over the demo pit and suspend a small monitor arm (max 50 lbs). Can you confirm max point load and ceiling height at island D3 so we can share with our rigging vendor?

Marissa — can you attach the crate manifest and confirm collateral counts (press kits, 2 demo laptops + spare power bricks, 300 postcards)? Also, Tessa — we need the staffing schedule you promised for booth shifts and a list of who will be onsite for set-up.

If morning window isn't possible we'll take the 3–5pm afternoon slot, but morning is strongly preferred.

Appreciate it —
Aditya Rao
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Per the hall schedule, we can provision the following dock slots for Redwood on Wednesday move-in:

- Slot 17: 07:00–07:30 — quick unload (small vans, no forklift).
- Slot 19: 07:30–08:30 — forklift access; recommended for heavy crates.
- Slot 33: 15:00–16:00 — afternoon slot (forklift available).

We can tentatively reserve Slot 19 (07:30–08:30) for you, but we need final confirmation and a signed MOP (method of procedure) by 5pm Tue (Mar 28). I've attached the signed_mop_techscale.pdf template for signature. Point load for the truss at island D3 is 120 lbs/point; clear ceiling height is 22'.

If you want Slot 19 we recommend the crates arrive in this order: Crate B (kiosk parts) first, Crate A (demo kit) second so the demo crate ends up closest to the pit.

Thanks —
J. Morales
